title: Implement trust-tier assignment for candidate sources
question_or_target: Target: assign each candidate a trust tier (first-party | vendor | community | unknown) from evidence (publisher identity, signature, repo ownership), and make the tier an INPUT to admission, not a label. Acceptance: an unknown-tier candidate cannot be auto-adopted; it can only be adopted after clean-room reimplementation or explicit owner approval.

evidence.claim: An unknown-tier fixture is refused by the admission path; the first-party twin of the same candidate is auto-adopted.

reviewer.note: Probe 2 re-runs assignment in two subprocesses with distinct injected clocks and AST-checks production functions for wall-clock calls.
